subject.title: Subagent sessions persist after completion, main session becomes unresponsive

question: Should completed run-mode subagent sessions be retained as visible history by default, hidden/archived automatically, or governed by an explicit retention policy?
rationale: The current source and tests preserve keep-mode run subagents, while the issue and docs expect cleanup or auto-archive; changing this default is a user-visible session-history and upgrade contract decision.

options.title: Preserve History, Fix Visibility
options.body: Keep completed child transcripts by default, but make session/task/Control UI/WebChat projections immediately mark them terminal and non-blocking, with explicit cleanup actions for pruning.

options.title: Auto-Archive Completed Runs
options.body: Archive or hide completed one-shot subagent sessions by default after terminal cleanup, accepting a retention behavior change that needs docs and upgrade proof.

options.title: Add Explicit Retention Policy
options.body: Introduce a subagent-specific retention setting only if maintainers decide existing cleanup and doctor/session maintenance surfaces cannot express the desired behavior safely.

recommendation.title: Preserve History, Fix Visibility
recommendation.body: Keep completed child transcripts by default, but make session/task/Control UI/WebChat projections immediately mark them terminal and non-blocking, with explicit cleanup actions for pruning.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-line and recent-history signal across the cleanup, archive, sweeper, and session-list behavior.
